svg.title: Issue 3 — Page 3 — Panel 1: Wide EST Clerkenwell street, Theodore on errand
svg.desc: Wide EST 28mm eye level. Narrow Victorian Clerkenwell street. Theodore walks along pavement carrying cloth-wrapped parcel — untidy sandy hair, worn waistcoat too large, patched wool trousers, scuffed boots. He is small in the frame, alone among adults who do not see him. Pedestrians in heavy coats; cart passing with horse on cobblestones. Sooty London stock brick, pie shop with steamed window, chandler's, unlit gas lamp. Grey Victorian daylight overcast and flat, soot dulling every surface. Small warm glows from shop windows punctuate the grey.
svg.text: Theodore Edmund Hartley. Twelve years old.
Apprentice to Mr. Cribbage, horologist, St. John's Lane.
